act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sub-section (3) of section 170, for the words “District Magistrate or Sub-divisional
text:
42. In sub-section (3) of section 170, for the words “District Magistrate or Sub-divisional

Magistrate”, the words “Chief Judicial Magistrate” shall be substituted.
